en.title: 20 Must-See Films Lighting Up TIFF 2026
en.summary: Get ready for a cinematic feast! TIFF 2026 is bringing the heat with a lineup packed with acclaimed directors, potential award contenders, and exciting new voices.
en.body:
The Toronto International Film Festival is gearing up for its 51st edition, and the buzz is already electric! With a curated selection of films poised to make waves, this is your essential guide to the cinematic event of the year.

## 1. Alpha Gang
Directed by the Zellner brothers, known for their distinctive indie spirit, "Alpha Gang" is a standout Special Presentation that promises their unique blend of humor and heart. Expect the unexpected from this auteur duo.

## 2. The Killer
David Fincher returns to the director's chair for "The Killer," a project that has cinephiles buzzing with anticipation. Known for his meticulous craft and dark, compelling narratives, Fincher's latest is sure to be a masterclass in suspense.

## 3. Perfect Days
Wim Wenders, a master storyteller, presents "Perfect Days," a film that has already garnered significant attention. This thoughtful exploration of life's quiet moments is a testament to Wenders' enduring ability to capture the human condition.

## 4. It's Me, Margaret.
Kelly Fremon Craig's "It's Me, Margaret." is set to charm audiences with its relatable story. Based on the beloved book, this film offers a poignant look at adolescence and self-discovery, promising a heartwarming experience.

## 5. Afire
Christian Petzold, a celebrated German filmmaker, brings "Afire" to TIFF, a title already generating considerable buzz from festival circuits. His nuanced approach to storytelling ensures this will be a film that lingers long after the credits roll.

## 6. Maestro
While details are still emerging, the inclusion of "Maestro" on this list signifies a major cinematic event. This film is expected to be a powerful biographical drama, likely featuring a star-studded cast and a compelling narrative.

## 7. Violent Night 2
Get ready for more festive mayhem! "Violent Night 2" is the highly anticipated sequel to the action-comedy hit. The first film delivered a unique blend of holiday cheer and brutal action, and fans are eager to see what comes next.

## 8. Dune: Part Three
Following the monumental success of its predecessors, "Dune: Part Three" is poised to continue Denis Villeneuve's epic saga. The sheer scale and visual ambition of this franchise make its inclusion a must-see for any fan of science fiction.

## 9. The Great Beyond
This intriguing title promises a journey into the unknown. While specific details are scarce, its placement on anticipation lists suggests a film with grand scope and thematic depth, potentially exploring new frontiers in storytelling.

## 10. The Beloved
Drawing buzz from previous festival appearances, "The Beloved" arrives at TIFF with a reputation for emotional resonance. This film is expected to be a deeply affecting drama that explores complex relationships with artistry and sensitivity.

Bottom Line: TIFF 2026 is shaping up to be an unforgettable cinematic experience, showcasing both established masters and compelling new voices in film.

content_raw: The 51st Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF) runs September 10–20 , and this year's lineup is one of the most stacked in recent memory. Across 11 days, 427 films of all genres will be screened across the city, with opening day alone featuring 98 premieres. The TIFF screenings are divided into regular and premium, with the latter categories including Galas and Special Presentations sections, which are the festival's most prestigious programming tier, drawing filmmakers and stars from nearly every corner of the industry.
